notes:
Account background:
- Mid-market SaaS (analytics product for B2B product teams). Heavy embedding + chat for support + doc search. Currently using another LLM API provider for production (vendor: OpenAI).
- Interested in Redwood because of predictable cost and Dedicated offering for multi-tenant isolation. Want same API ergonomics during migration.

Timeline / recent activity (shorthand):
- 2026-01-08: Intro call (Jordan) — discovery. PI: wants <150ms p95 for chat; 10-20 req/s per service. Mentioned ~2M tokens/day threshold to consider Dedicated.
- 2026-01-21: Demo — Redwood hosted API walkthrough (Nadia). Showed streaming + function call examples. Customer reaction: "nice telemetry, but need prompt parity tests."
- 2026-02-02: Sec review kickoff (legal + infra). Sent Redwood security FAQ (drive link). Legal flagged KMS & data residency.
- 2026-02-10: Deep dive POC scoping call (ff_meet_2026-02-10_7a9c). Agreed 3-week Hosted POC: integration shim -> parity test -> regression evals.
- 2026-02-18: POC env provisioned on Redwood Hosted (API keys, eval harness). First smoke tests run.
- 2026-02-25: Initial parity run completed. Findings: 1) tokenization differences cause ~4% change in prompt length accounting; 2) a small regression in finance-summary QA prompts (factual hallucination increase vs baseline).
- 2026-03-04: Engineering sync (Nadia + Trellis infra). Decided to test compatibility shim that maps vendor response meta and enforces same input tokenization (pre-tokenizer).
- 2026-03-08: A/B test plan created: 10k queries across support transcripts + 2k finance docs. Metrics: ROUGE, factuality spot checks, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens.
- 2026-03-09: QA ran first A/B batch. Noted improved latency but still 1.8% regression on finance factuality. Logged INF-3498.

Use-case / requirements summary (short bullets):
- Primary workloads: customer support chat (low latency), doc-search/embeddings for KB retrieval, automated summarization for weekly product reports.
- Targets: chat p95 <150ms; embeddings throughput 200 qps (batched); budget sensitivity: wants <= $0.60 per 1k tokens equivalent on cold estimate for Hosted.
- Model preferences: open models preferred for auditability; willing to use Redwood-verified models. Need routing fallback to lower-cost model under load.
- Migration needs: API compatibility shim (minimal code changes), prompt-parity mapping doc, eval harness to detect regressions.

POC deliverables & acceptance criteria:
- Integration guide + sample shim for their existing SDK -> Redwood Hosted.
- Prompt mapping doc showing tokenization differences and recommended normalized prompts.
- Regression report: pass if factuality delta <0.5% on finance test set AND latency target met.
- Pricing estimate for Dedicated if usage >2M tokens/day (include reserved capacity options).

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Price sensitivity discussed in pricing call 2026-02-28. Finance wants a clear Dedicated uplift vs Hosted and a 12-month commit discount schedule.
- They asked for a worked example: 3 tiered forecasts (base, expected, peak). Requested Redwood finance to provide a mid-market pricing worksheet.

Risks / open questions:
- Prompt parity: tokenization and small factual regressions need detailed triage.
- Legal: KMS integration strategy and data residency SLA required before Dedicated procurement.
- Migration effort: engineering wants a lightweight compat layer; wary of large re-prompting work.

Recent next steps (owner tags):
- Jordan: schedule pricing slot w/ finance for 2026-03-18.
- Nadia: finish shim example + push to POC repo by 2026-03-12.
- Trellis infra: run second A/B (full 12k) and surface regression diffs by 2026-03-14.

Direct quote / paraphrase from product lead: "If we can get parity with near-zero prompt changes and no regression on our finance reports, we'd move to Dedicated within the quarter."

Short-term plan: close Hosted parity POC → negotiate Dedicated reserved capacity (if telemetry shows throughput & cost justify).
